parameters.content:
## PaperShield letter workflow
Letter in (form or test webhook) → fixed input checks → duplicate check → **AI extracts facts only** (Gemini, quotes checked against the letter) → **fixed rules decide** (R0–R10, same as the app) → **a human approves or rejects** → calendar reminder (.ics) → log sheet → result email.
Errors (missing/wrong data, AI tool down) go to the **errors sheet**. Synthetic data only. Emails go to a local outbox; nothing is really sent.
Needs the helper running: `node helper/helper.js` (port 3457). The AI key is in .env, never in this workflow.
